sections.content: How many students stayed in Dorchester (West Dorset) after school?
Dorchester (West Dorset) is a small town in the South West. Dorchester (West Dorset) does not have a university.
In Dorchester (West Dorset), [description of cluster]. In this analysis, we’ve referred to towns like this as 2.

How many students left Dorchester (West Dorset)?

Of those who got degrees, 53% were living outside of Dorchester (West Dorset) in 2018/19.

Of those who completed other post-18 education, 36% were living outside Dorchester (West Dorset) in 2018/19.

However, some people who moved away from Dorchester (West Dorset) stayed within the same travel to work area, a larger area that includes where most of the local working population both live and work. Of all graduates that sat their GCSEs in Dorchester (West Dorset), 52% remained in the same travel to work area in 2018/19, while 47% moved further afield.

78% of skilled non-graduates from Dorchester (West Dorset) stayed in the same travel to work area in 2018/19, while 20% moved further afield.

36% of graduates were living in another English region in 2018/19.

7% of skilled-non graduates were living in another English region in 2018/19.
